plain: A small or too small amount

webster.text: Fewness; smallness of number; as the paucity of schools.

example.quote: The first objection that I shall consider is, that, by paucity of numbers, they will be more liable to depart from their duty, and more subject to influence.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 4, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
